text:
ana: quick heads-up — i'm kicking off a small canary for phrasing and glossary tweaks in the API docs. posting PR links below; looking for quick reviews from docs + eng by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: sounds good. which areas are changing? names/param casing or tone adjustments?

ana: mainly: 1) param naming consistency across SDK snippets 2) short tone polish for error messages 3) a couple glossary entries (kv-cache -> "Key-value cache") and 4) two broken links found in the embeddings guide.

priya: can you drop the PR numbers? i can pick up the link fixes.

ana: sure — PRs: 
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5142 (sdk-snippet-param-case)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5143 (error-microcopy-polish)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5144 (glossary-add-kvcache)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5145 (embeddings-links-fix)

lee: noted. for the SDK snippets, do we prefer `snake_case` or `camelCase` for params in examples? we had mixed patterns in the JS vs python snippets.

mike: agreed we need consistency. proposal: keep examples idiomatic per language (snake_case for python, camelCase for js/ts), but canonical param names in the API surface stay snake_case. docs should call that out.

ana: exactly — that's the plan. i'll add a small note in the SDK conventions page: "Examples are idiomatic; API param names use snake_case (canonical)."

priya: i'll take the links PR. quick question: embeddings guide has one external link and one internal anchor that's 404ing. want me to re-point the anchor or remove it?

ana: re-point to the subsection `embedding-best-practices` (the anchor changed in last restructure). leave a redirect entry if possible. thanks.

docs-bot: reminder: doc-PR reviewers should include at least one eng-approval for SDK changes and one docs approval for tone changes.

lee: for the glossary change, what exact wording do we want for KV cache? i've seen both "KV cache" and "key-value cache" used.

ana: prefer "key-value (KV) cache" on first mention, then "KV cache" thereafter. add cross-ref where we mention caching and prefix caching in the runtime docs.

mike: small nit on error messages PR — avoid contractions in system-generated messages per style guide (e.g., use "cannot" instead of "can't"). is that still current?

ana: yes — we decided last sprint: no contractions in error messages. i'll make sure PR 5143 runs a quick grep to catch any.

priya: done — i'm on 5145. i'll open a follow-up if redirect is needed for older links (redirect list in /docs/_redirects).

lee: what about tests/examples? should we add a snippet test for the JS example to the docs-snippet CI?

mike: yes please. add a small unit that runs `node examples/embedding.js` under docs-ci and assert it doesn't throw. keep it lightweight.

ana: good call. i'll add a tiny `examples/ci-check.js` and include it in the docs CI matrix. snippet: ```js
// examples/ci-check.js
const example = require('./embedding.js');
example().then(() => console.log('ok')).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });
```

priya: timeline? EOD reviews as you said, but can we stretch to tomorrow morning for eng approvals?

ana: fine — target EOD for docs approvals, tomorrow 11am PT for eng approvals. i'll post a follow-up summary after reviews.

mike: i'll try to review 5142 + 5143 tonight. ping me if anything blocks.

lee: i'll own 5144 (glossary) and add cross-refs.

priya: link fixes on 5145 done, pushed a tiny redirect. awaiting CI. :white_check_mark:

ana: thanks all. leaving a checklist here: 
- [ ] docs review (EOD)
- [ ] eng review (11am PT)
- [ ] add snippet CI check for js example
- [ ] glossary cross-refs + first-mention phrasing
- [ ] redirects for changed anchors

mike: 👍

docs-bot: deployment note — docs site will rebuild when PRs merge; small rebuilds take ~3-4 minutes.

ana: merging order suggestion: 5144 (glossary) -> 5142 (snippets) -> 5143 (microcopy) -> 5145 (links). rationale: glossary first so phrasing is stable for snippets, snippets before microcopy so examples match.

lee: makes sense. i'll wait to land 5144 then.

priya: CI green on 5145. going to mark ready to merge after eng thumbs.

ana: perfect. i'll send a short note in #product once merged that the phrasing canary is live and ask a few product folks to spot-check the customer-facing pages. :sparkles:

mike: thanks, team.

ana: thanks everyone — will post final thread when done.
